preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two lines.
The first line contains an integer n between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: s = lines[1].strip(); len(s) == n and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The second line contains a string s of length n consisting only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output is the processed string result.

postconditions.expression: def is_filler_prefix(sub): return sub.startswith('ogo') and all(sub[i:i+2] == 'go' for i in range(3, len(sub), 2)) and (len(sub) - 3) % 2 == 0; result == ''.join(['***' if is_filler_prefix(s[i:]) and (i == 0 or not is_filler_prefix(s[i-1:i+len(s[i:])])) else s[i] for i in range(len(s)) if not (i > 0 and s[i-1:i] == 'g' and s[i:i+1] == 'o' and i+1 < len(s) and s[i+1:i+2] == 'g' and is_filler_prefix(s[i-1:]))])
postconditions.description: The output string is formed by replacing every maximal contiguous filler sequence (starting with 'ogo' followed by zero or more 'go' pairs) with '***', ensuring no overlapping or partial replacements occur.
